Shadow-Cursed Harpers are Harpers who have been taken by the shadow curse and turned into mindless creatures. They can be found in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two.

Involvement

Act Two

Shadow-Cursed Harpers appear once  Halsin opens a portal to the Shadowfell during ⁠Lift the Shadow Curse. They are accompanied by  Shadows and attack on sight. The party must defend the portal while various shadow creatures, including Shadow-Cursed Harpers, attempt to attack it.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Spear
Damage: 4~9
1d6 + 3⁠Piercing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Ranged Attack ()   –  Light Crossbow
Damage: 1~8
1d8⁠Piercing
Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon.
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)

Loot

  • Spear or Greatsword or Mace or Light Crossbow or Longbow
  • Scale Mail or Leather Armour or Studded Leather Armour
  • Putrefied Tumour

Notes

  • Stats and items may vary, as Shadow-Cursed Harpers come in various different races and genders and equipment.
